verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email-marketing automation platform, so per-contact journey visibility and control is a fair question for it. The evidence only makes the generic claim that it can 'create customer journeys'. Nothing shows viewing where an individual sits in an automation, or removing or re-entering a person without disrupting the flow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
